month_summary: July 1916 marked the launch of the massive Battle of the Somme on July 1st with British mines and assaults capturing Mametz and Montauban. The Battle of Albert phase concluded July 13th after capturing villages including Fricourt, La Boisselle, Contalmaison, Trônes Wood, and Ovillers. The Bazentin Ridge battle followed July 14-17. On the Eastern Front, the Berestechko offensive began July 8th as part of the Brusilov offensive, while the Battle of Kowel started July 28th with an Austrian counter-attack. The Attack at Fromelles occurred July 19-20 on the Western Front. The Battle of Asiago concluded July 27th in the Italian Alps.
